result.instructions: Tools for Artesa, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which assignments are planned for our crews next week?"; "Show me all open assignments for customer Müller GmbH."; "Which staff members are on absence this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Artesa data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run artesa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run artesa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run artesa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. artesa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: artesa_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (private persons or companies that assignments are carried out for). Filter by company name, number or external id. Artesa API: GET /v2/customers.

external_id.description: Filter by the external id from your other system.

tools.name: artesa_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer with its phones, emails, URLs and billing address. Artesa API: GET /v2/customers/{customerUuid}.

customer_uuid.description: The customer uuid (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: artesa_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer record (company or private person). Not safe to retry: a retry creates a second customer. Artesa API: POST /v2/customers.

company_name.description: Company name (leave empty for a private person).

tools.name: artesa_list_assignments
tools.title: List assignments
tools.description: List assignments (orders/jobs) with their customer, project, type, responsible user and status. Artesa API: GET /v2/assignments.

customer_uuid.description: Only assignments of this customer uuid.

project_uuid.description: Only assignments in this project uuid.

type_uuid.description: Only assignments of this assignment type uuid.

responsible_user_uuid.description: Only assignments for this responsible user uuid.

status_uuid.description: Only assignments with this status uuid.

tools.name: artesa_get_assignment
tools.title: Get an assignment
tools.description: Get one assignment with its details. Artesa API: GET /v2/assignments/{assignmentUuid}.

assignment_uuid.description: The assignment uuid (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: artesa_list_assignment_events
tools.title: List assignment events
tools.description: List work steps (appointments and events) of assignments, optionally in a time window. Artesa API: GET /v2/assignment-events.

assignment_uuid.description: Only events of this assignment uuid.

type_uuid.description: Only events of this assignment event type uuid.

group_uuid.description: Only events in this assignment event group uuid.

starts_from.description: Events starting at or after this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z).

starts_to.description: Events starting at or before this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: artesa_get_assignment_event
tools.title: Get an assignment event
tools.description: Get one assignment event (work step). Artesa API: GET /v2/assignment-events/{assignmentEventUuid}.

assignment_event_uuid.description: The assignment event uuid (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: artesa_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects that group assignments. Artesa API: GET /v2/projects.

tools.name: artesa_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project. Artesa API: GET /v2/projects/{projectUuid}.

project_uuid.description: The project uuid (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: artesa_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (staff members) with their role. Filter by name, email or role. Artesa API: GET /v2/users.

role_uuid.description: Only users with this role uuid.

tools.name: artesa_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user (staff member). Artesa API: GET /v2/users/{userUuid}.

user_uuid.description: The user uuid (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: artesa_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List recorded time entries (work time) per user, assignment or event, optionally in a time window. Artesa API: GET /v2/time-entries.

user_uuid.description: Only entries of this user uuid.

assignment_uuid.description: Only entries on this assignment uuid.

event_uuid.description: Only entries on this assignment event uuid.

type_uuid.description: Only entries of this time entry type uuid.

day_status.description: Filter by the day status of the time sheet.

starts_from.description: Entries starting at or after this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z).

starts_to.description: Entries starting at or before this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: artesa_list_user_absences
tools.title: List user absences
tools.description: List absences (holidays, sick days and similar) of users in a time window. Artesa API: GET /v2/user-absences.

user_uuid.description: Only absences of this user uuid.

type_uuid.description: Only absences of this user absence type uuid.

starts_from.description: Absences starting at or after this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z).

starts_to.description: Absences starting at or before this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: artesa_list_time_sheet_weeks
tools.title: List time sheet weeks
tools.description: List weekly time sheets per user, with their status. Artesa API: GET /v2/time-sheet-weeks.

user_uuid.description: Only time sheets of this user uuid.

tools.name: artesa_list_assignment_status_types
tools.title: List assignment status types
tools.description: List the assignment status types (Auftragsstatus) your company uses. Artesa API: GET /v2/assignment-status-types.

tools.name: artesa_list_assignment_types
tools.title: List assignment types
tools.description: List the assignment types (Auftragstypen) your company uses. Artesa API: GET /v2/assignment-types.

tools.name: artesa_list_gangs
tools.title: List gangs

tools.name: artesa_list_roles
